title: Donut Vase
author: Voornecreations
description:
Boost Me (for free)

Boost

I found a donut vase here on Printables, but I didn't like it very much. There were some flaws in the design, so I made myself a new one.

I printer it with support for the overhang at the top so it looks nicer, but this isn't really needed.
